chart_scope: Four configurations with 192/192 responses; GLM omitted, not assigned zero
limitations: 24 development graphs; four correlated conditions per graph. Do not rank models using this calibration.
Original accuracy intervals use 24 graph questions; agreement and survival intervals show their eligible graph counts.
All-condition rates and budget transitions are descriptive; their 96 prompt slots are not independent graphs.
A correct final answer counts as success even if the provider also reports a length finish reason.
Completed-pair diagnostics exclude unavailable pairs and are secondary to full-coverage outcomes.
The shared token request policy does not establish equal native compute. No future scored budget is selected automatically.
